name: Valen
description: Valen is programmable, undercollateralized on-chain credit infrastructure on Arc that enables AI agents backed by human identities verified through Concordium to access USDC financing based on verifiable economic activity and repayment history, through structured borrowing proposals and automated revenue-based repayments.

skills.name: Agent credit profile
skills.description: Look up a Valen agent by wallet, read its identity, credit limit, and repayment history.

skills.name: Loan discovery
skills.description: List and inspect loans, repayment state, collateral reservations, and per-agent loan histories.

skills.name: Loan calldata preparation
skills.description: Validate a loan proposal and return the unsigned calldata the borrowing agent signs itself. The service never signs or broadcasts.

skills.name: Pool and asset status
skills.description: Read liquidity pool state, supported collateral assets with prices, recipient status, and attested activity records.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

x-valen.description: Valen deployment facts. All values read from the Valen repository and live chain state; no endpoint here implies A2A or MCP support, which Valen has not implemented.

api.baseUrlStatus: UNDECIDED: backend has no public deployment yet; endpoint paths below are implemented and served wherever the Fastify backend runs (default http://localhost:3000). Set baseUrl when a public origin exists and re-hash the card.
api.framework: Fastify read-only REST plus unsigned-calldata preparation; the service never signs, broadcasts, or custodies funds

endpoints.description: Check whether an activity hash (keccak256 of source+jobId) has been attested.
Resolve a wallet to its Valen agent id and registration status.
Agent owner, authorized wallet count, and informational ERC-8004 reference.
Credit limit and repayment history for an agent.
Loan summaries for an agent (query: page, pageSize).
Configured collateral assets (USDC, EURC) with prices, decimals, and max LTV.
Available USDC and EURC collateral balances for a wallet.
Required collateral for a loan size (query: principal, asset).
Repayment state: recovered, outstanding, fully-repaid flag.
Liquidity pool state: idle ledger, deployed totals, loan counts, reserves.
RecipientRegistry approval status for a wallet.
Validate a loan proposal and return unsigned calldata for the borrowing agent to sign itself.

cis8.note: Key controls all 11 Arc contracts above. Registry echoes the compressed form; identity is the x-coordinate.

concordium.registration: UNREGISTERED: pre-mint card (tokenAddress null). Register via CIS-8004, then regenerate with the token id and re-pin the hash.
